_doc: Tool model of Kleki (Pen brush, Pixel brush, Paint Bucket). brush/oil/watercolour = Pen (anti-aliased round, alpha = the pen opacity the emitter sets: kleki_opacity); pencil = Pixel brush (aliased); fill = bucket (4-connected, tolerance 0). Paint-only tools map to the Pen. Re-measure with calib-plan / calib-measure.

brush.fitted: 2026-10-25 calib on kleki.com in Safari (Mac): pen 100% alpha 0.997, 16.9 px at size 16.8; pen opacity builds up per dab (~4.2 dabs overlap): 81% -> 0.99, 60% -> 0.95, 11% -> 0.39; pixel 35% -> 0.357 (no build-up)
brush.speed_fitted: 2026-10-25 speed sweeps on kleki.com/Safari (settleMs 12): stepPx 16 cuts zigzag corners (1.5-10 % missing at 8000-20000 px/s); stepPx 8 at 8000 px/s and stepPx 4 at 1500-3000: 0 % missing for pen and pixel; fills 3/3 in every row; bucket 4-connected (probe)

_doc_speed: speed (px/s), stepPx and strokeGapMs per tool override the emitter defaults (8000, the tool stepPx, 2 ms); null = default. speed-calib / speed-measure find the fastest setting with no missing pixels.
